reddit.title: Introducing Material Management in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials list instead of a single cost badge. This change allows you to see exactly what resources are required for each building, making it easier to manage your colony's needs. You can now view stored vs. required materials and identify any shortages at a glance. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Improved Material Management System
steam.body: We're thrilled to introduce a new materials management feature in Provincia! Build tiles now provide a detailed overview of required materials instead of a single cost badge. This allows players to easily track what resources are needed for construction, view stored vs. required materials, and identify shortages at a glance. This update is designed to enhance your gameplay experience and streamline resource management. For more information, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
